description: Compare depletion and autocatalytic pathways across complete heating scans. The response is a measured calorimetric conversion rate, conditional on the source-derived conversion coordinate. Author-fitted curves are excluded.
independent_unit: Whole heating scans: train 1/5/10 Celsius per minute; dev 3; test 20. One encapsulant system; heating-rate transfer, not independent-batch replication.
limitations: Arrhenius effective kinetics over the measured thermal scans
Conversion and rate are related calorimetric reductions, not independent response channels
Known kinetic families; microscopic reaction mechanism is not identified
Kamal-Sourour family with shared coefficients across heating rates
title: Thermally activated encapsulant cure
